## Project Overview
My research project is about change in the incarcerated population of Texas between 2000 and 2026. I also hope to answer questions about if the rate of incarceration has changed and whether the crimes people are being charged with have changed. Additionally, this research project hopes to explore any demographic changes that have occurred within the incarcerated population of Texas.
